types.name: TextShimmerProps
types.doc: A calm light sweep across a short status line, such as "Thinking" or "Generating summary", to show that work is ongoing. The band uses the current text color over a muted base. When `active` turns false the band glides off and the text settles to solid. A changed label rises in place while the line springs to its new width. The component sets `aria-busy`; announce completion from your own live region.

members.name: children
members.doc: The status text. Keep it to one short line.

members.name: active
members.doc: Sweep while work is ongoing. Defaults to true.

members.name: duration
members.doc: Seconds for one sweep across the text. Defaults to 1.8.
